id: 636-第三次「星際大戰」（第四次卡拉科爾-納蘭霍戰爭）
theater: 貝里斯—洪都拉斯科潘河谷

battle.name: 第三次「星際大戰」（第四次卡拉科爾-納蘭霍戰爭）
battle.theater: 貝里斯—洪都拉斯科潘河谷
battle.brief: 公元六三六年，貝里斯山麓的卡拉科爾在王「鷹豹」率領下第四次深入洪都拉斯科潘河谷，了結六三一年星戰的舊賬：納蘭霍城被焚，君主再度被擒、被焚殺，佩滕南翼的城邦聯盟重排。卡面的羅馬重步兵從未出現在中美洲，它標示密集的近戰正面——長矛與棉甲盾牌結成的盾列，靠的是兵源與糧道，不是靠重裝。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 這場戰爭是瑪雅古典期東南部低地城邦體系裡的一次決定性衝突，交戰雙方都是獨立的城邦政治體，沒有宣戰程序，也沒有常備國軍。進攻方是貝里斯凱奧區的卡拉科爾，碑銘作 Uxwitza'，意譯「三水丘」，坐落在瑪雅山脈北麓的瓦卡台地上，核心建築群以「天宮」Caana 與主廣場四周的高層廟宇為中心，全城聚落範圍約二百平方公里。防守方是洪都拉斯科潘省科潘河谷內的納蘭霍，碑銘作 Naranj Ha，建築群沿 El Zapotal 一帶的山脊與階梯台地鋪開，大廣場是它的政治核心。卡拉科爾的兵員由王畿村落的常備與民兵抽調，骨幹是佩槍的貴族菁英，另有擲矛器手、弓手與少量投石手；納蘭霍同樣以佩槍突擊隊為核心，配弓手、擲矛手與持黑曜石柄劍的近戰兵。第三方是蒂卡爾——此時仍在「蒂卡爾中斷」的沉寂期，但與納蘭霍結盟——以及多斯皮拉斯、烏克薩克通、科潘等佩滕與科潘兩地的城邦。現存碑銘與考古材料都沒有留下本役的雙方兵員、陣亡與戰損數字，能確定的只是它的發起者、交戰地點與大致勝負方向。
countriesEn: This war was a decisive collision inside the system of Classic-period lowland Maya city-states. Both belligerents were independent city-state polities, with no declaration of war and no standing national army. The attacker was Caracol, in the Cayo District of Belize, called Uxwitza' in the inscriptions and rendered as Three Water Hill, standing on the Vaca Plateau in the foothills of the Maya Mountains; its core building group centred on the Caana and the high temple platforms around the main plaza, and the whole settlement zone covered roughly two hundred square kilometres. The defender was Naranjo, called Naranj Ha in the inscriptions, inside the Copan valley of Copan Department in Honduras, its building groups spread along the ridges and stepped terraces of the Zapotal zone, with the Great Plaza as its political core. Caracol drew its men from the standing levies and the militia of the villages round its capital, the backbone being the spearmen of the nobility, backed by atlatl throwers, archers and a few slingers; Naranjo was built the same way, around spear-bearing assault companies supported by archers, dart throwers and close-combat men with obsidian-bladed wooden swords. Third parties were Tikal, still in the silence of the so-called Tikal hiatus but allied to Naranjo, and such cities as Dos Pilas, Uaxactun and Copan in the Peten and Copan zones. Neither the surviving inscriptions nor the archaeological material preserves any headcount, casualty or loss figure for this war: what can be established is who launched it, where it was fought and roughly which way it turned.
people: 可點名的人不多，但有幾位留下了足夠多的痕跡。進攻方的核心是卡拉科爾王 K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo'，漢譯多作「鷹豹」，一般認為他在六二九年之後、七世紀六○至七○年代之間執政，並在六三六年主持了這次遠征；一九八五年在 B-37 號墓中出土的墓主，通過護目符神面式樣的戰盾——一件帶特奧蒂瓦卡風格、飾以豹紋與鷹喙的盾牌——以及隨葬的年輕戰士遺骸，被認定就是這位君主，同一座墓中還有活祭陪葬。卡拉科爾另一位已知最早的統治者 Te' K'ab Chaak，其四世紀墓葬在二〇二〇年代重見天日，出土玉質死亡面具與成套陶器，說明這座城的王統至少可以上溯數百年。防守方一側，納蘭霍伊察姆坎王朝的君主姓名在殘損碑文中已難完整釋讀，只能確定這位君主在本役被生擒並被焚殺；納蘭霍三十二號石碑上留下的斬首圖像、三十三號碑被有意磨去的碑文，正是這段記憶留下的物質痕跡。此外還有大批不留姓名的人：依金星曆定出出征日期的祭司、抄寫戰果的書記、在前線率領佩槍突擊的貴族隊長、負責贖回俘虜的中人，以及隨軍背運糧秣的勞役隊。
peopleEn: Few individuals can be named, but several left enough trace to be identified. At the centre of the attacking side stands the king of Caracol, K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo', rendered in Chinese as the Owl Jaguar, who is generally placed in power some time after 629 and through the 660s and 670s, and who is credited with leading the expedition of 636. The occupant of tomb B-37, excavated in 1985, is identified with this ruler on the strength of a war shield bearing the goggle-eyed deity mask, a shield in the Teotihuacan style ornamented with jaguar markings and an eagle beak, together with the remains of a young warrior buried with him; the same tomb also held a sacrificial victim. Another ruler of Caracol, Te' K'ab Chaak, the earliest ruler known there, has had his fourth-century tomb brought back into the light in the 2020s, with a jade death mask and a set of ceramic vessels, which shows that the line of kings at this city can be traced back several centuries. On the Naranjo side the name of the Itz'am K'an monarch can no longer be read in full from the damaged inscription: all that is certain is that the lord was taken alive and burned to death in this campaign. The decapitation carved on Naranjo Stela 32 and the deliberately erased text of Stela 33 are the material traces of that memory. Around them stand many who left no name: the priests who fixed the day of the march by the phases of Venus, the scribes who wrote down the result, the noble captains who led the spear charges in the field, the middlemen who handled the ransom of captives, and the porters who carried the grain behind the army.
kits: 卡面上這件羅馬重步兵（Legionary，約公元前100年）從未出現在中美洲。分段鎧甲配大弧形重盾的羅馬重步兵，靠的是盾牆式的正面、長矛與投射器的密度，以及後方不斷補上的兵源與糧道，這些都與瑪雅戰場無關。放到本役，與它功能相當的是瑪雅城邦的佩槍菁英：長矛配棉甲與盾牌結成的正面。瑪雅的裝備可分五層。第一層是近戰：木柄上鑲黑曜石或燧石刃的黑曜石木劍 macuahuitl，須雙手揮砍；石斧與木棍；以及矛尖為石、骨或黑曜石的長矛。第二層是投射：擲矛器 atlatl 配加重前端的細長木矛，是最普遍的投射武器；短弓與箭；石彈投石索。第三層是防護：菁英穿以棉絮填充的夾層棉甲 ichcahuipilli，外罩獸皮，配木框蒙獸皮綴羽的圓盾 chictli 與綴石的小方盾 tecpatl，頭戴硬木或獸皮頭套，重要人物另有護肩與神像面具。第四層是攻城與破壞：木梯、繩索、破門用的斧與火攻草束，瑪雅建築多為木構茅頂，一經點燃便難以撲救；本役的焚城正是靠這一套。第五層是後勤：瑪雅沒有馭獸，糧秣、矛束、繩梯全靠人背，渡科潘河與烏拉河改用獨木舟，主食是玉米、豆類、南瓜與鹹魚，可可則用於儀式交換。羅馬重步兵那句「戰力靠補充兵源與補給線」的話，在瑪雅城邦的常備制度裡找不到對應物——那裡的戰力來自一次次的城邦結盟與星戰義務。
kitsEn: The Roman legionary named on the card (Legionary, about 100 BC) never fought in Middle America. The segmented armour and the large curved shield of the Roman heavy infantry rested on a shield-wall front, on the density of spears and missiles, and on man-power and supply lines fed in from behind; none of that belongs on a Maya battlefield. What corresponds to it in this war is the spearmen elite of the Maya city-states: a front of spears, padded cotton armour and shields. The Maya equipment can be read in five layers. First, close combat: the macuahuitl, a wooden club with obsidian or flint blades set into the handle, which had to be swung with two hands; stone axes and clubs; and long spears whose points were of stone, bone or obsidian. Second, missiles: the atlatl with its weighted slender dart, the commonest missile of all; short bows and arrows; and stone-weighted throwing cords. Third, protection: the elite wore layered cotton armour stuffed with cotton batting, the ichcahuipilli, covered with a hide, and carried a round hide-framed shield trimmed with feathers, the chictli, or a small square shield studded with stone, the tecpatl, together with a hardwood or hide cap, while men of rank added shoulder guards and deity masks. Fourth, siege and destruction: wooden ladders, rope, axes for breaking doors, and bundles of burning thatch; Maya buildings were timber-framed with thatched roofs, and once lit they could hardly be saved, and it was this kit that burned Naranjo down. Fifth, logistics: the Maya had no draft animals, so grain, dart bundles and rope ladders all travelled on human backs, the Copan and Ulua rivers were crossed in canoes, the staple food was maize, beans, squash and salted fish, and cacao was used in ritual exchange. The line on the card, that Roman strength came from the replacement of men and from supply rather than from heavy armour, has no counterpart in the institutions of the Maya city-states, where power was assembled afresh with every alliance and every star war.
tactics: 瑪雅人的「星戰」不是單純的比武，而是一場被星辰與雨神恰克指定義務的攻擊：由城邦的議事團體提出請求，王室祭司依金星曆算定出征日期，出兵多選乾季，攻入城後須俘獲對方君主或貴族、焚其偶像，再以儀式收束。本役的行程是這樣的：卡拉科爾自瓦卡台地出發，經阿爾通阿一線向東南翻越山脊，沿查基布爾商路下到洪都拉斯側的科潘河谷；這條路沒有可供車馬通行的寬路，遠征隊只能輕裝先鋒在前、糧秣隊與俘虜隊在後，行程被溪流與山脊切斷，缺水與連日行軍是最大負擔。接戰多在城前廣場與台地邊緣：擲矛手在數十步外排成散兵線齊射，弓手分佔兩翼，佩槍手以盾牌相接頂住對方躍前的突擊者，接近後改用木劍與石斧貼身廝殺；貴族之間往往先以單挑定勝負，把對方君主活捉視為戰果。攻城時先斷田禾與水源，再點燃倉房與廟宇，最後以梯與繩索攀上台地。撤退則是有計畫的破壞：砍伐果樹、焚燒田舍、遷走人口，使對方在下一個收成季失去稅基。雲雨、溪澗與密林是雙方共同的障礙，因此縱火與破壞多集中於可燃的建築，而非夯土或石砌的核心。
tacticsEn: A Maya star war was not simply a contest but an attack carrying an obligation assigned by the stars and by the rain god Chac: the community of the city asked for it, the royal priests fixed the day of the march by the phases of Venus, campaigns were mounted in the dry season, and once inside the enemy city the attackers had to take the opposing lord or his nobles, burn his effigies, and then close the rite. The shape of this campaign was as follows. Caracol set out from the Vaca Plateau, crossed the ranges to the southeast by way of the Altun Ha line, and came down into the Copan valley on the Honduran side along the Chiquibul trade road. There was no broad track on it for carts or horses, so an expedition could travel only with a light vanguard in front and the grain train and the column of captives behind, the march being cut by streams and ridges, with the shortage of water and days of walking the heaviest burden. Contact was usually made on the plaza before the city and along the edges of the terraces: dart throwers fired in loose order from several dozen paces, archers took the flanks, spearmen locked shields together against the leaping assault of the other side, and once they closed they fought at close quarters with wooden swords and stone axes, while among the nobles a single combat often settled the matter, and the taking of the opposing lord alive counted as the trophy. In a siege the attackers first cut crops and water, then fired the storehouses and the temples, and only at the end climbed the terraces with ladders and rope. Withdrawal was a planned destruction: fruit trees cut, farmsteads burned, people moved off, so that the enemy would lose its tax base in the following harvests. Cloudbursts, streams and dense forest were obstacles shared by both sides, and for that reason the burning and the damage were concentrated on the flammable buildings rather than on the rammed-earth or stone core.
data: 可引的數字集中在幾處。地理上，卡拉科爾的坐標是北緯十六度四十五分五十秒、西經八十九度七分三秒，海拔約五百公尺，遺址範圍約二百平方公里；考古計畫自一九八五年起持續發掘，二〇一〇年五月公布的機載雷射測繪把周邊二百平方公里一次掃出。納蘭霍在科潘河谷內，約北緯十四度五十五分、西經八十九度九分。兩地直線相距約二百公里，若經阿爾通阿繞行則接近三百公里，遠征隊連同糧秣隊一般要走十至十四日才能抵達城下。整批星戰銘文共記十三場，橫跨五六二至七八一年，時間分布集中在十一月至翌年一月的乾季，九月中至十月下旬的收穫期完全沒有記錄，本役的月份按此置於十二月，屬約數。納蘭霍大廣場一帶的焚燒痕跡與三十二號碑的斬首圖像，是本役最直接的物質記錄。至於兵力與損耗，沒有任何來源可以支撐數字，只宜說納蘭霍城內主要建築群被焚、村落人口外流。
dataEn: The figures that can be cited fall into a few groups. In geography, Caracol stands at 16 degrees 45 minutes 50 seconds north, 89 degrees 7 minutes 3 seconds west, at an elevation of about 500 metres, and the site covers roughly 200 square kilometres; the archaeological project has been excavating there since 1985, and the airborne laser survey flown in the spring dry season of 2009, published in May 2010, swept some 200 square kilometres of the surroundings in a single pass. Naranjo lies inside the Copan valley at about 14 degrees 55 minutes north, 89 degrees 9 minutes west. The two sites are roughly 200 kilometres apart in a straight line, and rather close to 300 kilometres if the road is followed via Altun Ha, so an expedition with its grain train generally needed ten to fourteen days to reach the enemy walls. The whole corpus of star war inscriptions records thirteen engagements spread across 562 to 781, concentrated in the dry season from November into January, with no record at all in the harvest window from mid-September to late October; the month given for this war follows that pattern and is an approximation, placed in December. The burn traces in and around the Great Plaza of Naranjo and the decapitation carved on Stela 32 are the most direct material record of the campaign. As for strength and losses, no source supports any number, and the only safe statement is that the principal building groups of Naranjo were burned and that population moved out of the villages.
cause: 打起來有幾層原因，最表面的是六三一年星戰留下的未了之事。瑪雅人的「星戰」是一種帶義務的襲擊：一旦宣戰並燒了對方首領的偶像，衝突便不算結束，直到雙方互換俘虜、首領歸位、儀式走完；前一場納蘭霍君主被擒殺、俘虜未贖、偶像未毀，於是這筆賬必須用一場更大的星戰去清。深一層是走廊霸權之爭：納蘭霍與蒂卡爾結盟，使卡拉科爾的南翼暴露，而查基布爾商路上的鹽、黑曜石、翡翠、可可與棉花，正是這條走廊的交換骨架；誰控制山口與渡口，誰就抽得出關稅與貢賦。再深一層是城邦聯盟的整體傾斜：五六二年卡拉科爾擊敗蒂卡爾之後，低地的均勢本已西移，納蘭霍正是蒂卡爾在南翼的支點，一旦被拔掉，佩滕盆地南方便再沒有第二座能頂住卡拉科爾的城邦。最後是象徵與王權層面的競爭：新王「鷹豹」需要一次在儀式上完滿的勝利來坐實自己的正統，而納蘭霍越是被神話化，這一場敗績就越不能容忍。
causeEn: There are several layers of reason behind the fighting, the outermost of them being what the war of 631 left unfinished. For the Maya a star war was an attack carrying an obligation: once war was declared and the effigy of the opposing chief burned, the conflict was not over until the captives had been exchanged, the lord returned, and the rite completed. The previous round had left the Naranjo lord killed, the prisoners unransomed and the effigies unburned, and that account had to be settled by a greater star war. One level deeper lies the struggle over the corridor: Naranjo's alliance with Tikal exposed Caracol's southern flank, while the salt, obsidian, jade, cacao and cotton of the Chiquibul road formed the exchange skeleton of that corridor, and whoever held the passes and the fords could levy tolls and tribute. Deeper still is the general tilt of the city-state system: since Caracol had beaten Tikal in 562 the balance of the lowlands had already shifted west, and Naranjo was the pillar Tikal held in the southern wing; once that pillar was removed there was no second city in the southern Peten able to stand against Caracol. Last of all came the competition over symbols and kingship: the new ruler, the Owl Jaguar, needed a victory that was complete in the terms of ritual to make his own legitimacy secure, and the more mythological Naranjo was made, the less tolerable a defeat at its hands could be.
impact: 直接效果是東南低地權力版圖的一次重排。納蘭霍在此役之後再未恢復六世紀的規模：El Zapotal 區與大廣場一帶的人口外流，耕地廢耕，碑銘與墓葬的規格一路下滑；曾經以星戰聞名的伊察姆坎王朝，其王室的正當性在這場焚城與斬首之後被削到谷底，納蘭霍此後只能以附庸身份存在，直到六八○年才反過來在星戰中擊敗卡拉克穆爾，勉強找回一點舊日體面。卡拉科爾則坐實了對貝里斯—洪都拉斯走廊的霸權，並把六三六年的戰果寫進王權宣傳：墓中那面特奧蒂瓦卡風格的「鷹豹」戰盾、一九八五年 B-37 號墓的發現，以及卡拉科爾考古計畫在東南聚落區發現的戰後人口增長，都說明這次遠征帶來的是結構性的轉移，而不是一次性的斬首。長期看，這場勝利把低地的均勢推向東南，也把卡拉科爾推到一個無法退讓的位置上：七三○年代，多斯皮拉斯—烏塔特蘭聯盟在蒂卡爾王賈索·錢·卡維爾一世率領下攻破卡拉科爾，一座數百年盛名的城邦就此崩解。星戰的邏輯在這裡閉合：摧毀別人的城邦，最後往往變成自己的墳墓。
impactEn: The immediate effect was a reordering of the power map of the southeastern lowlands. Naranjo never recovered its sixth-century scale after this war: residents of the Zapotal zone and of the Great Plaza moved away, fields were abandoned, and the scale of the monuments and of the tombs declined steadily. The Itz'am K'an dynasty, once famous for its star wars, had the legitimacy of its rule cut to the ground by the burning of the city and by the decapitation, and Naranjo henceforth existed as a client, until in 680 it turned the tables and beat Calakmul in a star war of its own, recovering a little of the old standing. Caracol, for its part, confirmed its primacy over the Belize-Honduras corridor and wrote the result of 636 into royal propaganda: the Teotihuacan-style Owl Jaguar war shield from the tomb, the discovery of B-37 in 1985, and the post-war growth of population that the Caracol project found in the southeastern residential sector all show that this expedition produced a structural shift rather than a single execution. In the long run the victory pushed the balance of the lowlands southeast and left Caracol in a position it could not retreat from: in the 730s a Dos Pilas-Uzatlan coalition led by the Tikal king Jasaw Chan K'awiil I broke Caracol, and a city of several centuries' standing came apart. The logic of the star war closes here: to destroy another city-state's capital often turns into one's own grave.
result: 就現有材料可判斷的方向看，這一仗以卡拉科爾的完勝告一段落：納蘭霍城被焚，君主再度被生擒並被焚殺，大廣場與周邊廟宇付之一炬；這是有銘文可查的第三次星戰，也是瑪雅星戰記錄中最徹底的一次城市攻擊之一，後世論述引用最多的「星戰」範例之一。對卡拉科爾而言，目標達成——領地被拓、盟邦重排、對手在儀式上被抹去；對納蘭霍而言，這是一場從此無法翻身的敗仗，其首都的繁榮、其王室的威信、其商路上的位置，在兩三個收成季內一併失去。六三六年因此成為東南低地的一個分水嶺：它把五六二年以來蒂卡爾體系崩解所留下的權力真空，交到了佩滕盆地東南的山麓之手。餘波仍未完：六三一年欠下的賬在六三六年一次清掉，但新的賬很快又來——六五七年多斯皮拉斯攻入佩滕，六七七年拉科羅納與多斯皮拉斯相繼在星戰中擊敗蒂卡爾，七三六年卡拉科爾自己也走向崩潰，納蘭霍則在六八○年短暫回光。真正解決這條走廊權力格局的，是七三六年之後蒂卡爾與佩滕盆地南緣之間的又一番折騰，而六三六年這場戰爭，是其中最先被寫下的那一頁。
resultEn: On what the surviving material allows us to judge, the battle ended in a complete victory for Caracol: Naranjo was burned, the lord was taken alive for the second time and burned to death, and the Great Plaza and the temples around it went up in flame. This was the third star war for which there is an inscription, and one of the most thorough urban attacks in the whole Maya corpus, and one of the most frequently cited cases of a star war. For Caracol the object was achieved: territory opened, alliances rearranged, the opponent symbolically unmade. For Naranjo it was a defeat from which there was no recovery, for the prosperity of its capital, the prestige of its rulers and its place on the trade road were all lost within two or three harvests. The year 636 therefore became a watershed in the southeastern lowlands: it handed over to the foothills southeast of the Peten Basin the power vacuum left behind by the break-up of the Tikal system that had begun in 562. The aftershocks did not stop there. The account left over from 631 was settled in a single campaign, but new accounts came quickly: in 657 Dos Pilas struck into the Peten, in 677 Lakamhaun and Dos Pilas beat Tikal in successive star wars, in 736 Caracol itself came apart, and Naranjo enjoyed a brief recovery in 680. What actually settled the pattern of power along this corridor was the renewed shuffling between Tikal and the southern rim of the Peten after 736, and the war of 636 is the first page of that sequence that was ever written down.
